architectureChosen: Inline \s+ substitution within the existing RULES array's own regex literals - no new abstraction, no phrase-builder utility, no text-preprocessing/normalization step.

alternativesConsidered.option: Preprocess/normalize the whole document text (collapse all whitespace) before running RULES against it.
alternativesConsidered.reason: Explicitly warned against by the mission's own Section 4 - would destroy the character-position meaning that Tier 2's earliestRuleMatch/CAPTION_ZONE_CHARS/AMBIGUITY_GAP_CHARS logic depends on, and would also require re-deriving SELF_REFERENCE_WINDOW slicing against a different text than doc.text.

alternativesConsidered.option: Build a generalized phrase-to-regex helper function (e.g. wordsToPattern(['amended','and','restated'])) and rewrite RULES to call it.
alternativesConsidered.reason: A larger refactor than this bug's own scope warrants - introduces a new abstraction with its own testing/maintenance surface for a fix that is otherwise a direct, auditable one-line-per-pattern regex edit. Rejected per the general engineering discipline of not adding abstraction beyond what the task requires.

alternativesConsidered.option: Inline \s+ substitution within existing regex literals (CHOSEN).
alternativesConsidered.reason: Matches the mission's own suggested example (docs/final-phase3-closure/02-classifier-whitespace-audit.json's own fixMechanism) exactly. Zero new abstraction. Every changed line is independently auditable in a plain git diff. Preserves 100% of existing position-aware Tier 2 logic (matches still run against raw text; only the amount of whitespace between words each regex tolerates changed).

invariantsPreserved.positionFirstTier2: earliestRuleMatch still computes m.index against the SAME raw preamble text - \s+ never changes what character index a match starts at, only what it is willing to skip over internally before the next literal token.
invariantsPreserved.selfReferentialTier1: SELF_REFERENCE_RE and findRuleMatchForType(selfTerm) are unchanged; findRuleMatchForType calls findEvidence(rule.patterns, term) against the SAME (now whitespace-tolerant) RULES patterns, so a self-referential term that itself spans a line-wrap now also correctly resolves - a generalization of the same fix, not a separate code path.
invariantsPreserved.ambiguityGuard: BASE_REFERENCEABLE_TYPES/CAPTION_ZONE_CHARS/AMBIGUITY_GAP_CHARS/matchesOverlap logic entirely untouched - operates on the same { index, evidence } shape regardless of how many literal characters a match's evidence string spans.
invariantsPreserved.tocExhibitResistance: The self-referential-title-first architecture (Tier 1 before Tier 2, earliest-match-wins within Tier 2) is architecturally independent of the whitespace-tolerance fix - unchanged code paths, verified by the full pre-existing C1-C10 TOC/exhibit adversarial test suite still passing unmodified (see 04-classifier-generic-tests.json).

scopeDiscipline: No Superior-specific text, no issuer/package/document IDs, and no Superior-tuned regex literal was added anywhere in this diff - every changed pattern remains a generic English financing-document phrase (verifiable directly in the diff: only \s vs literal-space characters changed, no new words/phrases/strings were introduced).
